audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagree with the page's own prose: rows 0, 3 and 4 read Skill while whys[0], whys[3] and whys[4] all say the stage is Kled's, and row 6 reads Kled while whys[6] says Vladimir takes it.
audit.why: The packet chart is Kled for rows 0-5 and Vladimir for row 6 — identical to the seven why-rows. The mirror already flipped rows 3, 4 and 6 on Kled's side, so leaving them here would put the two directions in direct conflict.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 flipped to Kled and row 6 to Vladimir, as four matched full/content pairs in one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike named the ultimate but gave no cooldown and missed the shield entirely.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and travels 3500 units, and Riot's text says he gains a shield on the charge — the shield is what makes the all-in unanswerable, not just the range.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten around the 140s cooldown, the 3500 range and the arrival shield, with Sanguine Pool held for the ram.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to pool the Bear Trap 'to break the tether before the yank'. Riot's text does not support that, and pooling is the wrong answer regardless — the trap is a projectile.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is flagged projectile at 800 range against Transfusion's 600; sidestepping it costs nothing while pooling burns a 28s cooldown you need for the Chaaaaaaaarge!!! ram. Dismounted, his damage to champions drops and his Q becomes a ranged knockback — that state, not his cooldowns, is your trade window.
audit.corrected: Sidestep replaces pool on the trap in tldr, dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text; the dismount damage penalty stated in tldr and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing told the reader that his burst opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Violent Tendencies is an auto reset granting four fast attacks on a 13s cooldown — the wind-up is the tell, not a cast animation.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0].text and the cooldown block.

edits.before: Q-poke + pool his pull — out-scale his dismount. Vladimir wins the Bear Trap on a Rope cooldown windows.
edits.after: Q-poke and dodge the trap — dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions, so that is your window.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Pool/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1, 800 range — a projectile, so sidestep it. - Violent Tendencies: 13s of four fast attacks. - Jousting: 13s, and he can dash back. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s at rank 1.

edits.before: His engage hook. Pool/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 11s at rank 1, 800 range — a projectile, so sidestep it, don't pool.

edits.before: Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) pull plus Violent Tendencies (W) attack-speed burst shreds you in melee; never get hooked by his Q, and pool if he lands it to break the tether before the yank.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) is an 800-range projectile — sidestep it and the yank never happens. Violent Tendencies is four fast attacks on a 13s cooldown; the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast.

edits.before: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) lets Kled engage from a screen away and remount for a full HP bar — his all-in threat peaks here and you can't out-trade the remount burst, so play for range and CS.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and reaches 3500 units, and it hands him a shield on arrival — his all-in peaks here, so hold Sanguine Pool for the ram and play for CS.

edits.before: Poke him while he's dismounted (low HP Skaarl-less state)
edits.after: Poke him dismounted — he deals less damage to champions then

notes: The claim that pooling breaks the Bear Trap tether before the yank is not supported anywhere in the kit data — untargetability and tether-breaking are separate mechanics and Riot's text says nothing about it. I removed the advice rather than assert either way, and replaced it with the sidestep, which is correct regardless. If the user knows the pool interaction does work, that is worth restoring as a separate line. report[8].t on this matchup recommends anti-heal 'his healing fights your pattern' — Kled has no healing in his kit, only Skaarl's courage remount; that line looks like template bleed and should probably be dropped, but I left it since I could not confirm whether remount counts as healing for Grievous Wounds.
